# Garage Comparison

Five Rezvani builds side by side, distilled from the configurator PDFs.

| | [[Vengeance - War Wagon]] | [[Vengeance - Fortress]] | [[Vengeance - Tank]] | [[Vengeance - Dark Knight]] | [[Vengeance - Spectre]] |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Total** | $771,500 | $592,685 | $481,085 | $425,800 | $485,000 |
| **Engine** | 810 HP Supercharged V8 | 5.2L Supercharged V8 | V8 Demon Package | 1,000 HP Twin Turbo V8 | 6.2L V8 (stock) |
| **Armor** | B6 + B5 upgrade | B5 upgrade ($150k) | B5 upgrade ($115k) | Dark Military Package | Security Package |
| **Personality** | War room on wheels | The bunker | The showpiece | Stealth assassin | Escape artist |

## Read the table
- Cheapest: **Dark Knight** ($425,800) — most horsepower per dollar, blackout stealth
- Most armored: **War Wagon** — B6 composite plus the B5 upgrade
- Most dramatic seats: **Tank** (Gladiatore, yellow stitching)
- Only one with escape gadgets: **Spectre** (smoke screen, EMP shield, ram bumper)
- Best off-grid: **Fortress** (Off-Grid Package)

Shared across the fleet: Shinedown logo (War Wagon & Spectre), roof LED light
bar, night vision, center console safe, solar options.

imports/Classified/9th Circle Directorat.raw:
The Ninth Circle Directorate is an elite internal division of the [[Veil Concordat]] responsible for high-impact strategic interventions.

Unlike mythologized depictions, the Directorate does not rely on supernatural abilities.

Its power derives from advanced intelligence analysis, behavioral prediction, technological superiority, and psychological operations.

Members are selected based on cognitive resilience, ethical adaptability, and capacity for long-term mission focus.

The Directorate intentionally recruits individuals from diverse cultural backgrounds and gender identities.

Personnel profiles include:

transgender operatives specializing in social infiltration

gay and bisexual analysts experienced in network psychology

heterosexual field strategists with military intelligence backgrounds

non-binary systems architects managing predictive modeling frameworks

This diversity is viewed not as symbolism but as operational advantage —
expanding perspective reduces strategic blind spots.

Some intelligence observers speculate that Lazriel operates adjacent to this division rather than within it.

Parent organization: [[Veil Concordat]]

imports/Classified/Core Concept 2.md.title: Core Concept 2
imports/Classified/Core Concept 2.md.raw:
Lazriel functions as a living corrective force within the world.

They do not serve chaos.
They do not serve order.

They serve [[Balance]].

Where systems destabilize — politically, socially, existentially — Lazriel appears.
Not as a conqueror, but as a scalpel.

Their actions often prevent greater catastrophes…
though the moral cost remains debated.

Many scholars classify Lazriel as an embodiment of necessary consequence.

Information regarding the exact cause remains fragmented due to widespread data corruption and deliberate archival suppression.

The event resulted in long-term geopolitical restructuring and accelerated the growth of covert intervention groups.

Several modern operational doctrines and psychological containment strategies trace their evolution to lessons learned during this crisis.

Related developments:
- emergence of advanced predictive intelligence frameworks
- expansion of clandestine equilibrium organizations
- refinement of symbolic enforcement methodologies

A raven diving downward

A dagger forming the spine

Wings curved like a mourning veil

A skull hidden in negative space

Matte black ink with faint crimson accents

The card represents:

inevitability

silence

final judgment

Victims rarely understand its meaning.<br>Survivors build their lives around it.
